---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new use for Syllavox
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What would you like to do?

Describe the user outcome, not only the implementation idea.

## Why would this be useful?

Who would benefit and what problem would it solve?

## How would you expect it to work?

Describe the simplest useful version of the feature.

## Alternatives

How do you handle this today? What existing Syllavox feature is close but not
quite enough?

## Local-first considerations

Would this feature involve downloaded data, external services, voice models,
browser permissions, or new local files? Mention any privacy or licensing
considerations you see.
